title: The California ZIP nonrenewal gradient is largest in the joint low-income/high-wildfire-risk screen
source_unit: California ZIP-level FAIR/private-market measures joined to ACS context and CDI county wildfire exposure
geography: California ZIP/ZCTA approximations with county exposure context

denominator.unit: ZIP rows with FAIR share, voluntary decisions, ACS context, and county exposure context

low_income_high_risk_nonrenewal_rate.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions; 167 ZIP rows

low_income_low_risk_nonrenewal_rate.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions; 225 ZIP rows

high_income_high_risk_nonrenewal_rate.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions; 454 ZIP rows

high_income_low_risk_nonrenewal_rate.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions; 724 ZIP rows

observations.method: Joined FAIR share and 2022 voluntary ZIP counts to ACS median household income and structure files, then assigned CDI county high/very-high exposure share; split income at the lower quartile boundary ($63,990) and risk at CDI's published 12.1% statewide share.
observations.uncertainty: This is a descriptive stratified place screen. Risk is modeled and temporally based on 2015 dwelling-unit estimates; ACS is a five-year ZCTA estimate; FAIR and voluntary measures have different universes.
observations.subgroup: ZIP rows in four income-by-risk cells; cells are unweighted and unequal in size.
observations.counterinterpretation: The pattern can reflect property value, detached/mobile composition, insurer mix, county composition, reporting practices, or other omitted conditions; it does not establish that risk or income caused nonrenewal or that households moved into FAIR.

related_sources.claim: Local output records the all-dimension join, cut points, cells, and decision counts.
related_sources.access_boundary: The screen is descriptive and not population-weighted.

related_sources.claim: CDI supplies the county wildfire-exposure context.
related_sources.access_boundary: The exposure estimate uses a 2015 dwelling-unit base and weighted modeler scores.

boundary: This record tests whether the California FAIR/private-market pattern survives joint income and modeled wildfire-risk conditioning. It does not establish causality, household affordability, coverage adequacy, repairs, moves, lending effects, or political response.
